| --- | --- |

| To request a feature | [Open a feature request](../../issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) |

| To report a security issue | [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) — never a public issue |

## Before asking for help

1. Read the README and the docs.
2. Search existing issues and discussions.
3. Try to reproduce the problem on the latest version.

When asking, include: what you did, what you expected, what happened,
your OS, the version, and any relevant logs.
